components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). On create a national number is accepted and
            normalized (assuming country code '+61' when none is given).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. When omitted on creation it defaults
            to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name and address (they share a household). Write-only; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded
                sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:

                name who were created with 'sharesHousehold' true. Absent for owners not part of a
                shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:

              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented the `membershipNumber` assignment, formatted `<customerCode>-M<YY>` where `YY` is the last two digits of the `registrationDate` year (e.g. `SMI-0007-M26`), following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions and mirroring the existing `customerCode` machinery.

Changes:
1. **`Owner.java`** — added a persisted `membershipNumber` field (`@Column(name = "membership_number")`) with getter/setter, next to `customerCode`.
2. **`AssignMembershipNumber.java`** (new) — an OfficeFloor function that reads the owner via `@Val`, computes `customerCode + "-M" + <2-digit year>`, and sets it. `String.format("%02d", year % 100)` guarantees the two-digit, zero-padded `YY`.
3. **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the new step in after `assignCustomerCode` (so both `customerCode` and `registrationDate` are already set), under the same `transaction` governance, feeding into `assignNamesakeCount`.
4. **`openapi.yml`** — added a `readOnly` `membershipNumber` property to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it into the JSON the test reads (MapStruct maps it by name automatically).
5. **`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`** — added the `membership_number` column (tests run under `hsqldb` with `ddl-auto=none`, so the column must exist in the schema script).

Test result: `./mvnw test` → **BUILD SUCCESS**, `AcceptanceTest` (`coreMembershipNumberFormat`) passing (1 run, 0 failures).
